name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: This role is the technical execution side of the same work I already do at Solenzo, building and documenting AI-driven automation for small businesses, just applied to your law firm clients instead of mine. I built a 20-plus-workflow GoHighLevel automation system spanning lead capture through reactivation, and I translate ambiguous business requirements into structured AI prompts and agent logic as a matter of daily practice, not a one-off project.

Documentation is not an afterthought in how I work. I log every configuration and deliverable so engagements stay auditable, and I built rubric-based grading criteria to QA AI-generated output before it ever reached a client, rather than trusting model output directly. I have hands-on production experience across Zapier, Make, and n8n, including custom Python and JavaScript code steps, and I am comfortable executing independently from a scoping document without needing step-by-step direction, since that has been how I have run my own practice for the last two years.

I do not have legal-tech-specific experience, and my background has generally been client-facing rather than pure back-end delivery, but the technical work this role describes is exactly what I already build. I would welcome the chance to bring that to your engagements.
